verdicts.reason: A keeps the headphone-in-circle art and a clear CTA, but the OBSIDIAN logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck in the bottom-right corner (a brand failure). The $349 price floats centred above the headline with no link to it or the CTA, and a large dead gap separates the copy from the button. B is worse: the teal circle and the headphones are pulled apart, leaving an empty disc on the far left. The copy is broken up, with the body text cut off from its headline and stranded on the far right, the price floating apart from everything, and the CTA jammed next to the logo mid-banner. There is no clear reading order.
